title: FilePreview
description:
Every version of one file that the setup has, as pictures for the
window: the copies in archives first, the one the game uses last.

path.description: The file, below the data directory.

versions.description: Its versions, the one the game uses last.

ModRef.description: A mod as a mod manager knows it.

id.description: The manager's own identifier of the mod.

name.description: The name to show to people.

source.description: The manager that knows this mod, for example `vortex`.

archive.description: The archive it is in, or `None` for a loose file.

image.description: The picture, a PNG as a `data:` address, if the file could be shown.

provider.description: The mod it comes from, if the mod manager knows.
